name: Nest Basis Vault
oneLiner: nBASIS is Nest's basis-trade vault token combining Superstate T-bill collateral with perpetual shorts; value drifts with funding-rate, not pegged 1:1.
collateral: Basis-trade strategy book combining Superstate USCC (CME-futures crypto carry) and Superstate USTB (short-duration U.S. Treasuries), plus Midas mBASIS (delta-neutral basis trade using CEX perpetuals); USCC trades through CFTC-approved CME venues while the mBASIS sleeve uses CEX perpetuals.
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and drifts with the basis-trade strategy NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

oracleRisk.summary: nBASIS is a Nest NAV vault receipt token whose value is determined by the vault's strategy accounting and redemption value, not by borrower-specific collateral liquidation oracles.

branchApplicability.rationale: Nest documents nBASIS as a vault token representing a share of a basis-trade strategy. Users deposit supported stablecoins to mint shares and redeem shares for the vault's redemption asset; the reviewed product and integration material does not describe borrower debt positions, collateral-ratio checks, or liquidatable collateral markets.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Nest publishes nBASIS through Nest product documentation with Ethereum, Plume, and Plasma deployments. No external bridge protocol evidence was resolved, so the reviewed route is issuer/protocol-native multichain issuance.

review.evidence: Both nBASIS Teller (0xAD60d4...) and Manager (0x17767f...) return owner() = 0xa08a0dc... at Ethereum block 25295023. That address is a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 confirmed via getOwners(), getThreshold(), modules(), guard storage slot, and masterCopy slot. No modules, no guard. Upgrade follow-up on 2026-07-21: the nBASIS token at 0x11113ff3a60c2450f4b22515cb760417259ee94b is a directly deployed BoringVault contract, not a proxy. The EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero on Ethereum block 25580348, Plume block 82434036, and Plasma block 27687550. The Ethereum bytecode-derived verified source/ABI has no upgradeTo or upgradeToAndCall entry point; administrative ownership and authority can change permissions and vault parameters but cannot replace the deployed mint-critical bytecode. Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nBASIS supply to portfolio assets was found. Nest DAO LLC is a Marshall Islands DAO LLC, not a prudentially supervised fund issuer.
